name: Royal Heritage & Wilderness Tour
summary: The pinnacle of Ranthambore wildlife luxury. 4 private tiger safaris, 5-star heritage resort accommodation, Chambal river crocodile cruise, and dedicated naturalist escort.
highlights: Chambal River Gharial & Crocodile boat safari

items.title: 4 Exclusive Tiger Safaris
items.text: Cover multiple varied zones across morning and afternoon shifts for maximal sighting chances.

items.title: 3 Nights Heritage Resort Stay
items.text: Luxury heritage property with royal Rajput architecture, private pool, and spa.

items.title: Chambal River Boating Included
items.text: Excursion to the National Chambal Sanctuary to spot Gharials and rare river dolphins.

items.title: VIP Transport & All Meals
items.text: Full board dining, private cab transfers from Jaipur/Delhi, and personalized concierge.

blocks.heading: Expedition Day-by-Day Schedule
blocks.intro: An immersive journey across prime jungle habitats, river wildlife, and royal heritage.

items.label: Day 1
items.title: Royal Welcome & Sunset Safari
bullets: 11:00 AM: Private luxury transfer arrival. Traditional Aarti & welcome drink at your heritage resort.
01:00 PM: Gourmet Rajasthani lunch in the royal courtyard.
02:30 PM: Safari Drive 1: Afternoon core zone tracking. Sunset birding around Padam Talao.
07:30 PM: Evening wildlife documentary screening with bonfire and heritage folk music.

items.label: Day 2
items.title: Core Zone Tracking & Fort Heritage Walk
bullets: 06:00 AM: Safari Drive 2: Misty dawn safari exploring deep rocky ravines for big cats.
11:00 AM: Brunch at the resort followed by spa therapy relaxation or swimming pool leisure.
02:30 PM: Safari Drive 3: Afternoon drive covering alternative zones with active tiger cubs.
07:30 PM: Private candlelight dinner by the pool.

items.label: Day 3
items.title: Dawn Safari & Chambal River Excursion
bullets: 06:30 AM: Safari Drive 4: Final morning tiger tracking drive with senior naturalist tracker.
01:30 PM: Motorboat river safari at National Chambal Sanctuary. Spot Gharials & marsh crocodiles.
05:30 PM: Visit the 10th-century Ranthambore Fort and Trinetra Ganesha Temple.
08:00 PM: Farewell Gala dinner with chef special delights.

items.label: Day 4
items.title: Sunrise Walk & Departure
bullets: 08:00 AM: Organic farm breakfast & peaceful nature stroll.
11:00 AM: Check out and private transfer to Jaipur Airport or Sawai Madhopur station.

items.title: Royal Suites & Tents
items.text: Private sit-outs, marble bathrooms, antique four-poster beds, and butler assistance.

items.title: Ayurvedic Spa & Wellness
items.text: Rejuvenate tired muscles after a bumpy safari with signature herbal massages.

items.title: Royal Dining Experience
items.text: Authentic Shikari curries, clay-oven kebabs, and candlelit courtyard dining under stars.

items.q: Why take 4 safaris instead of 1 or 2?
items.a: Tigers are wild predators that roam vast territories. Taking 4 safaris across 3 full days gives you morning and evening coverage across different zones, maximizing your cumulative tiger sighting probability to over 95%.

items.q: Can this package be customized with Jaipur pickup and drop?
items.a: Yes, private round-trip transfers from Jaipur Airport or Delhi NCR in an air-conditioned Innova Crysta can easily be added to your booking.

items.q: Are all forest permits guaranteed for private Gypsies?
items.a: Yes, when booked in advance, our team secures exclusive Maruti Gypsy permits registered directly under your passenger names.

blocks.title: Reserve Your 3N/4D Royal Tiger Expedition
blocks.text: Experience the untamed royalty of Rajasthan in grand style. Speak with our luxury safari concierge for bespoke customization.
